q: "T'ousand t'anks, matam, t'ousand t'anks," he continued, dropping into his half-accurate half-blundering broken English, "for dis great honor, such as we might not expect das laty of das house to wait for us at her door."
1860, J[ames] Fenimore Cooper, The Redskins; or, Indian and Injin: Being the Conclusion of the Littlepage Manuscripts, page 187:
